thesis: Build an orbital narrative where restrained terrestrial grooves evolve into expansive celestial sweeps, making 'another planet' feel like a gradual departure from gravity.

artist_branding.summary: Marsh is associated with polished melodic-house storytelling: emotional depth, progressive layering, and cinematic long-form arrangement that rewards disciplined restraint before lift moments.
visual_cues: Wide atmospheric beam fields with clean melodic contour
Cool-space palette foundations with selective luminous highlights
Long-range phrase architecture that favors narrative continuity
do_not_copy: Do not recreate exact visual identities, branded scenography, or one-to-one cue patterns from official Marsh live/tour content.

motifs: Geometry motif: orbiting arcs that repeatedly depart center then re-lock on a new axis
Color motif: deep indigo and cyan atmosphere with occasional white-star punctures
Movement motif: slow rotational travel in verses and tighter thrust patterns in drop/chorus peaks

visual_direction.color_story: Anchor the show in nocturnal blue-cyan tones and use bright white like star events, only at structural apex points.
visual_direction.motion_story: Favor smooth orbital movement early, then increase directional urgency as sections imply launch and transit.
visual_direction.staging_story: Let PAR texture provide space ambience while movers and NI arcs define trajectory, distance, and return vectors.

must_include: At least one long atmospheric segment that reads as weightless drift
Distinct shift from grounded verse behavior to expansive chorus/drop behavior
A late-stage high-clarity moment that signifies arrival beyond the initial space
avoid: Continuous front-facing blast looks that erase depth
Frequent random position hops without orbital logic
Overusing white so climax events lose meaning
